patch.purpose: Propagate normal and fallback UKI/initramfs build and install failures, finish other selected kernels, and retain an aggregate failure through post-hooks and final removed-kernel cleanup.
patch.removal_trigger: Recheck on the next upstream producer release; remove when upstream passes the patched-result contract without this patch.
patch.scope: Shell build/install results only. Existing kernel selection, per-kernel build fail-fast, configuration, naming, and hooks are retained. This is not an expected-output inventory or proof of native entry-tool publication.

patch.purpose: Propagate detected native addition, copy, attempted hash, backup, configuration write, sync and rename failures; preserve owned scanner mount cleanup and treat path arguments and diagnostic messages literally.
patch.removal_trigger: Recheck the next upstream release; remove when upstream passes the same native failure and successful-no-op contracts.
patch.scope: Detected publication failures only. No complete output inventory, atomic multi-file publication, signing policy, native deletion guarantee or lifecycle protocol is added. Missing optional hash-tool availability keeps upstream policy.

test.input: The complete bound Java source set is copied and verified before compilation. Both versions execute actual publisher classes. JDK25 is supplied by the caller; package builds use the recipe's separately hash-bound GraalVM archive.
test.isolation: Bubblewrap user/mount/PID/network namespaces, read-only runtime/JDK, fixture-only filesystem/configuration/HOME/XDG, bounded Java heap and processor count. No host-execution fallback. External hash/sync/logger/cleanup commands have controlled fault injection.
test.scope: Tests supply Config directly and exercise the real manager, reader, writer and helpers. They do not exercise full production configuration admission, FAT discovery or the whole scanner path; scanner cases cover its owned-mount scope. Production FAT validation is unchanged. Packaged CLI, firmware and boot acceptance are separate.
test.logs: LIMINE_NATIVE_KEEP=1 retains the printed private source/class/fixture/transcript directory; otherwise cleanup removes it.

test.input: No network access by the test. Supply the extracted pinned archive or an equivalent tree containing the three files above. The test copies and verifies each input SHA-256 before execution, verifies the patch and patched bytes, and leaves the caller's source unchanged. The archive digest binds the fetched archive; per-file digests are the executable input contract.
test.requires: Linux with unprivileged Bubblewrap user namespaces, merged-/usr runtime libraries, Bash, GNU coreutils, awk, util-linux flock, jq, patch, and ShellCheck.
test.isolation: Execute the complete real producer, common functions, and CLI wrapper in a private mount/PID/network/user namespace. Only runtime libraries and an explicit utility list are exposed read-only; /etc, /usr/lib/modules, /sys, /var, /boot, HOME and XDG paths are fixtures. mkinitcpio, entry-tool, pacman and host probes are fake commands. No OmaSecBoot core is sourced.
test.logs: Set TMPDIR to an owned private scratch parent. LIMINE_PRODUCER_KEEP=1 retains the printed per-run directory with source copies, fixtures and logs; otherwise the test removes it on exit.
